decision: Authorize (or move elsewhere) the one-line edit to .agents/skills/trust-appraise-all/SKILL.md and its .claude mirror that restores the authority-map link and turns main green?
whyItMatters: The knowledge-contradiction Class B envelope forbids .agents/skills/**, so a Steward dispatch would have stopped on this correction. It was made in a human-reviewed draft PR as a separate commit (b6e2d05), which is not an authorization. Until you authorize it, it is an exception, not a Class B closure.
evidence: Main's Python Package workflow failed on 2026-10-27 in 3 tests (tests/steward test_knowledge_contradiction_sensor_healthy_on_real_repo and 2 cases in tests/test_curation_authority_map.py) because trust-appraise-all lacked a link to docs/agents/curation-authority-map.md.
The change adds one sentence with that link to both mirrored copies; the mirror check, quick_validate_skill and validate_skills pass; an independent Sonnet verifier passed it.
Review by mbtiongson1 on PR #2202 (2026-10-28) asked for explicit authorization or a move to an authorized owner workflow.

Follow-up comment by mbtiongson1 on PR #2202 (2026-10-28): merged PR #2178 intentionally converted both mirrors into a minimal compatibility alias for gaia-tm-inspect but dropped the authority-map reference the Python Package tests require; this edit restores only that reference (2 lines per mirror) and keeps the alias and implicit-invocation policy. Recommended retaining it, no split into another PR, and not treating it as a blanket widening of the Class B lane; asked that the authorization of the .agents/skills/** touch be documented.
recommended: Retain the commit on this PR as a one-time, path-specific exception for this single reference sentence; the knowledge-contradiction route's forbiddenPaths stay unchanged and the lane is not widened. Status stays open until you state the authorization explicitly on the PR.
alternative: Move the commit to its own infra/ PR (reviewer said this is not needed).
unblocks: Counting the knowledge_contradiction debt and the red Python Package check as closed.
